lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy/layout/redesign, home hint/layout, sign_in hint/incentive/layout/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) is helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification), waiting screen info (home, wait_info), waiting screen redesigns (home, redesign), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than noise-corrected measured results.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for adoption certificate screen
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout that prominently displays the adopted pet.
candidates.why: Redesigning adoption screens has delivered winning results in past tests, and adoption has a long median duration of 89s.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the adoption certificate screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have consistently delivered winning results (+4.0% measured across 6 tests).

candidates.title: Pet style selector sub-flow on pick friend screen
candidates.change: Add an interactive choice card component to select pet color variations during friend selection.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet results looking wrong or failing; explicit style selection improves user expectations.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet color choice component to the pick friend screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and funnel, but new sub-flows add friction and require code changes.

candidates.title: Centered layout redesign for story intro screen

candidates.why: The choose_path step loses 16.9% of users; a cleaner centered narrative screen improves initial engagement.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the story screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns historically show slight negative returns (-0.3%).

candidates.title: Two-column layout redesign for waiting screen
candidates.change: Redesign the pet setup waiting screen into a balanced two-column view separating status from pet previews.
candidates.why: The waiting/home step takes a mean duration of 2336s and loses 18.7% of users; layout redesign improves visual clarity.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the waiting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Home waiting screen redesigns have measured -1.1% lift in previous tests.

candidates.title: Sign-in retry hint on sign-in screen

candidates.why: 2 support emails reported sign-in screen stalling or not appearing, causing 24.0% dropoff at sign-in.

sign_in.hint: If sign-in stalls, check your internet connection or restart the app.

guard.reason: Valid sign-in troubleshooting hint addition within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from emails and funnel, low implementation cost, but hints on sign-in measured -0.3%.

candidates.why: Finish step has the biggest drop-off (35.2%) with a mean duration of 5815s; 3 support tickets reported confusion over controls.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the home intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step is the biggest bottleneck with support complaints; single test showed +1.3% lift.

candidates.title: Compact layout redesign for photo upload screen
candidates.change: Switch the photo upload screen to a compact layout bringing upload buttons closer to photo guidelines.
candidates.why: Adoption step has high mean time (1017s); compacting layout speeds up the custom pet creation process.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign of the photo upload screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes showed negative measured results (-1.0%) with thin evidence.

candidates.title: New pet care guide screen before adoption certificate
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_pet_guide' right before adoption certificate explaining how desktop pet interactions work.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding; introducing pet care guidance earlier reduces confusion.

new_pet_guide.headline: How Your Pet Lives On Your Desktop
new_pet_guide.body: Your pet walks around your screen. Right-click the system tray icon anytime to hide or interact.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new pet care guide screen within onboarding preserving all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens to onboarding flows consistently hurts conversion despite support email complaints.

candidates.title: Troubleshooting checklist component on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Add a quick sign-in help checklist component on the sign-in screen to resolve account stalls.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing/reset pets after sign-in and 2 cited sign-in stalls, leading to 24.0% dropoff.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a sign-in assistance component on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 10 support emails and high sign-in dropoff; incentive/checklist measured +2.6%.
